display.notes: Play is always a borderless full screen window (--fullscreen=true has no effect). The setting replaces --resolution_scale=3 of the arguments, which stays when the resolution is the game's own.

apps.source: README: 'Tekken 6 Builder.exe' builds the game from the player's ISO into a folder of their choice. tools/portable_launcher.cpp: tekken6.exe there (D3D12) asks for the internal resolution and starts bin\tekken6.exe (the ReXGlue host) with the game, user and cache folders; tekken6_vulkan(_fbo).exe pick Vulkan. Build 0.9.4 (2026-11-15, seen in a played install) ships only the D3D12 ROV launcher. Play skips the launcher (it asks for the resolution every time, and with REX_USER_LANGUAGE set it loops on 'profile changed'): it starts bin\tekken6.exe with the launcher's arguments, the game's language from Playnite and a borderless window ('--fullscreen=true' has no effect), as the player's own Tekken 6 (ES).bat did; 'Launcher' keeps the original. User data: always user\ next to the launcher.

setup.notes: 'Tekken 6 Builder.exe' (no command line of its own found) runs builder\python\python.exe -X utf8 -I builder\build_from_iso.py with --iso, --output, --builder-root and --project (all required, argparse in build_from_iso.py) and optional --d3d12-rov, --vulkan-fsi, --vulkan-fbo; the install line above is that call, not tried by hand. An update builds again from the image; no update-only command. The update line builds again into the installed folder (where tekken6.exe is): not verified that build_from_iso.py accepts a folder that already has a build.
